name: Spotify

http.reason: Spotify Client Credentials 换取 access token
Spotify 搜索接口（按名称或 ISRC 检索艺术家）

description: Resolves artists to Spotify IDs with the Client Credentials flow: exchanges client id/secret for a token, then searches by artist name or ISRC (`/v1/search`) and persists only the ID. Requires the client ID and client secret of a Spotify app from the developer dashboard. Use "Test connection" to verify the credentials can obtain a token.
author: TMA
